PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: Drive rovers and ships with rotors, pistons or hinges without waiting for the server.
PluginData.Description: Sir Correctifs Pulsar turns on, on your machine only, two predictions Space Engineers already has but keeps off. Wheeled vehicle prediction: the rover you drive and each of its wheels are simulated on your machine, so it answers your keys at once. Mechanical blocks prediction: a ship that carries a rotor, a piston or a hinge is simulated on your machine when you pilot it, its attached parts with it. Each setting is turned on or off separately in the plugin settings; both are on by default. Nothing changes on the server: players without the plugin play as usual. The only thing the plugin sends is its own error reports, cleaned of any player data, and only on Sirius servers. The game's own safeguards stay in place: when the server's corrections pile up, the game goes back to server driven movement by itself.
